description: Rank the offerings in one market by price, quality and speed, with optional requirements and a maximum price. Returns prices with their verification date and source.

filters.description: Requirements. Attribute keys come from describe_market. Do not add filters the user did not ask for.

attr.description: Attribute key from the category's attribute list

op.description: eq: equals; lte/gte: numeric bounds; in: value is one of a list; has: boolean is true or tag list contains value

include_unverified.description: Also rank offerings whose price is an unverified sample, never checked against the provider (default false: left out)

maxPrice.description: Upper bound in the market's pricing unit (USD)

sort.description: score (default): best match for the weights; price: cheapest first; quality: best first

weights.description: What matters, each 0..1. Default: cost 0.5, quality 0.4, speed 0.1

cost.description: How much a lower price matters (0..1)

speed.description: How much speed / low latency matters (0..1)

name: search_offerings
title: Search and rank offerings
